note: Loss profiles for the EV accept rule (tameru.decide EVPolicy, tameru.plan): what a wrong prune is expected to cost. Every number carries the source it was read from and an 'unverified' flag; a flagged figure is an assumption until the named measurement lands. Nothing here is a host default.

p_needed.source: assumption: share of kept lines a later request actually needs

p_recovered.source: Hermes P2c replay: facts kept or recoverable via read-back on 91-98% of rows

recovery_output_tokens.source: assumption: output tokens of one read-back answer

lambda_base.source: assumption: catastrophic-loss unit, in multiples of the item's own tokens

less.source: design constant: conservative strength penalises a miss 10x

more.source: design constant: aggressive strength discounts a miss 10x
